BL-851 — Swarm stamp-off: the bridge now serves sideload APKs pre-auth on the public tunnel; verify the guard before it stays
What it solves: Also uncommitted in the same working tree, surfaced but NOT ticketed:
`swarmforge/packs/mono-router.conf` sets `active_backlog_max_depth` from
`1` to `-1` with a dated operator comment. That is a documented operator
knob deliberately set, not code — it belongs in the BL-848 ledger as a
`waived` can…
Approval context: This one was NOT filed by the human — the specifier found it uncommitted in the master checkout on 2026-08-07 while speccing BL-848, with no intake and no ticket. Two things need a ruling.
(1) IS IT INTENDED? A deliberately unauthenticated route on a publicly-tunnelled bridge is a real security dec…
BL-851 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-851" (or "reject BL-851 <reason>") to act.
